questions.prompt: According to my ____, we owe a lot of money in taxes this year.
questions.explanation: My cần danh từ calculations: theo các phép tính của tôi, chúng ta phải nộp nhiều thuế.

questions.prompt: Those ____ on my desk contain all the information we'll need for preparing our taxes.
questions.explanation: Those cần danh từ số nhiều files, phù hợp với động từ contain và ý hồ sơ nằm trên bàn.

questions.prompt: It is usually advantageous for spouses to file their income taxes ____.
questions.explanation: Jointly là trạng từ bổ nghĩa cho file: vợ chồng khai thuế chung.

questions.prompt: We didn't know we had to claim the interest from our savings account and were ____ for the error.
questions.explanation: Were penalized là bị động quá khứ: chúng tôi bị phạt vì sai sót khai lãi tiết kiệm.

questions.prompt: The ____ of the forms took much less time than we expected.
questions.explanation: The preparation of the forms cần danh từ preparation làm chủ ngữ, chỉ việc chuẩn bị biểu mẫu.

questions.prompt: I didn't overpay my taxes this year so I didn't get a ____.
questions.explanation: Sau a cần danh từ số ít refund: không nộp thừa thuế nên không được hoàn thuế.

readingPassage:
April 1, 20—
Mr. Roger Earnshaw
2943 Northern Boulevard
New Orange, NH
Dear Mr. Earnshaw,
Enclosed are your completed tax forms, which I have prepared for you at your request. I am sorry to report that you will
not receive the $500 refund that you expected. Instead, my calculations show that you owe $450 in taxes, as well as an
additional penalty of $45 for underpayment of taxes. The reason for this is that you and your spouse have chosen not to
file your taxes jointly this year. You may want to reconsider this for the future since, as you can see, it is more costly for
married couples to file separately. If you and your spouse wish to continue to file separately, you may want to ask your
employer to withhold a greater amount from your paychecks so that you don't end up owing money again next year. This
will be even more important if you get the salary increase that you have been hoping for.
Write out a check for the taxes that you still owe and the penalty and mail it together with your tax forms before the
April 15 deadline. Please let me know if I can be of any further assistance.
Sincerely,
Kathleen O'Hara
CPA

questions.explanation: Người viết nói đã chuẩn bị biểu mẫu theo yêu cầu và ký CPA, nên là người làm dịch vụ khai thuế.

questions.prompt: What is the total amount that Mr. Earnshaw owes?
questions.explanation: Khoản phải trả gồm $450 tiền thuế và $45 tiền phạt, tổng cộng $495.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. O'Hara recommend to Mr. Earnshaw to improve his tax situation?
questions.explanation: Thư đề nghị yêu cầu chủ lao động withhold a greater amount from your paychecks để tránh thiếu tiền thuế năm sau.

questions.prompt: The word jointly is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Jointly nghĩa là cùng nhau, đối lập với separately được nhắc ngay sau đó, nên chọn together.

questions.prompt: The word deadline is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: Deadline là ngày cuối phải nộp hồ sơ và tiền thuế, tương đương due date.
